brand.intro: I’m Paul Rabas. I create honest, useful content about places, people, public life, and the questions we encounter every day.
brand.footer_tagline: Stories worth seeing. Information worth knowing.

about.heading: Curiosity led me here.
about.lead: Most of my work happens behind the scenes in public service and legislative work. A lot of it involves reading, drafting, revising, and trying to understand how things work.
about.body: Paul Today gives me space to follow that curiosity outside my usual work. Dito ko gustong magkuwento tungkol sa mga bagay na napapaisip ako, from public issues to people, places, and everyday life.

portfolio.title: Explainers
portfolio.description: Complex topics presented in a way that is easier to follow, with the context people need to understand the issue.

portfolio.title: Current Conversations
portfolio.description: Current topics and public concerns, with enough context to make the conversation easier to follow.

portfolio.title: People & Places
portfolio.description: Stories about interesting people, places, and events, including details that may be easy to miss.

portfolio.title: Everyday Life
portfolio.description: Everyday experiences, personal interests, routines, and little discoveries along the way, from things I enjoy to moments worth sharing.

stories_intro.heading: See what I’ve been working on.
stories_intro.body: This is where I’ll share explainers, conversations, and everyday stories on video. New uploads will be added here as Paul Today grows.
